name: The Fate of Zephras
summary: In Valanaar, you bring Talaanis Shadowsong word of the danger facing Zephras. The fallen wards leave the isle exposed to Al'Akir, and its people must decide how to protect their home.

sections.title: A warning for Talaanis
sections.body: You tell Talaanis what happened above the Shrine of Akir. You share Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle. High Elder Shadowsong needs to understand the danger and why you were sent to Azeroth. The people of Zephras must find a way to save their home.

sections.title: What remains
sections.body: Talaanis weighs the news. Lorthuna is gone, and the cult has lost its leader. Zephras has not been invaded. Yet Al'Akir may turn his attention to the isle in years or decades, and fear now stands beside cause for celebration.

faq.answer: You speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
You tell Talaanis what happened above the Shrine of Akir and of Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle.

faq.q: Why are the people of Zephras afraid of Al'Akir?
faq.answer: The wards that hid Zephras have fallen. Al'Akir may choose to attack while the people are in his domain.

faq.q: What does High Elder Shadowsong need to know?
faq.answer: High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger and what the people of Zephras intend to do on their mission to Azeroth.
